stories.title: The war in Iran has left hundreds of U.S. diplomats in limbo
stories.description: As the U.S-Iran war ramps up again, hundreds of diplomats are in limbo. The State Department drew down staffing due to Iran's attacks on Gulf states. It's unclear if they'll return to normal business.

stories.title: The war with Iran is escalating. What next?
